title: Nek5000：譜元素階數、局部節點與全域自由度
titleEn: Nek5000: spectral-element order, local nodes and global degrees of freedom
subcategoryTitle: 地球、流體與離散物理驗證
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「Nek5000：譜元素階數、局部節點與全域自由度」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付局部節點帳本、介面共享圖、純量與向量容量表及 p 精化證據。
summaryEn: Investigate Nek5000: spectral-element order, local nodes and global degrees of freedom using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver local-node ledgers, an interface-sharing diagram, scalar and vector capacity tables and p-refinement evidence that does not conflate local storage with global degrees of freedom.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「次數與節點命名」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Name degree and node count: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 誤差可能是 N 與 N+1 混淆、向量分量漏乘或把局部副本當全域未知數；三者需不同資料欄位。
節點數驗收不證明 p 精化已收斂；需固定物理問題比較目標量、積分精度與實際採用的空間。
提高譜元素階數會增加每元素節點，但共享介面的局部副本不是新增全域未知數；先分清儲存與數學維度。
optionsEn: Errors may confuse N with N+1, omit vector components or mistake local copies for global unknowns. Each failure requires a different accounting correction.
A correct node count does not prove p-refinement convergence. Compare target observables, integration accuracy and the actual approximation spaces under an unchanged physical problem.

Raising spectral-element order adds local nodal values, but duplicated interface values are not all distinct global unknowns. Separate local storage accounting from the mathematical size of the assembled problem.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。提高譜元素階數會增加每元素節點，但共享介面的局部副本不是新增全域未知數；先分清儲存與數學維度。 與本階段判準一起判讀：每元素 512 個局部值；七的三次方是錯誤計數。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Raising spectral-element order adds local nodal values, but duplicated interface values are not all distinct global unknowns. Separate local storage accounting from the mathematical size of the assembled problem. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Each element has 512 local values; cubing seven is an incorrect count.
